xp.name: Unofficial Windows XP Service Pack 4 3.1b (harkaz)
xp.name_pl: Nieoficjalny Service Pack 4 dla Windows XP 3.1b (harkaz)
xp.licence: none stated (repackaged Microsoft updates; not redistributable)
xp.notes: EXCLUDED: built largely from Windows Embedded POSReady 2009 / WEPOS updates licensed for another product, and it enables the POSReady Windows Update trick; forbidden for Charon. The project's own page is the author's RyanVM forum thread (linked as author page and version history from download listings; the author's GitHub account has no repositories). On 2026-11-25 ryanvm.net/forum returned HTTP 500 to every request, so the current contents could NOT be verified on the project's own page, and nothing was downloaded. What download listings that link that thread say (secondary, unverified): version 3.1b dated 2016-04-17, stated to be the final release, file WindowsXP-USP4-v3.1b-x86-ENU.exe about 992 MB, English x86 only, needs XP SP1 or later, installs on a live system or slipstreams into install media; a cumulative rollup of updates for most XP components including Media Center and Tablet PC, request-only hotfixes, several .NET Framework versions with post-end-of-life updates up to January 2016, security registry hardening by Stefan Kanthak, and the POSReady registry key so Windows Update offers POSReady updates (3.1b removes that key on new installs). NOT DOWNLOADED, NOT HASHED. read 2026-11-25

xp.name: One-Core-API 4.0.10
xp.licence: GPL-2.0 (source repo shorthorn-project/One-Core-API-Source); binaries repo states no licence
xp.notes: EXCLUDED: origin is not clean. The binaries README (shorthorn-project/One-Core-API-Binaries, formerly Skulltrail192) states support for XP RTM to SP3, XP x64 SP1/SP2 and Server 2003, but also says 'This software utilizes modified files from the respective systems' (modified Windows binaries), lists 'Native apps from Windows Vista/7' (Windows 7 Paint, Wordpad, Sticky Notes, games), and its Extras repo provides D3D Native 'based on native Windows Directx Runtime'. It warns it can corrupt systems. Release 4.0.10 (2026-08-15) assets: one-core-api-pack-x86.zip 139268668 bytes, x86-pae, x86-avx and x64 (188 MB) variants. The source repo One-Core-API-Source is GPL-2.0. NOT DOWNLOADED, NOT HASHED. read 2026-11-25

xp.name: One-Core-API Extras
xp.notes: EXCLUDED: same project; README says the packages are for XP SP3, XP x64 SP2 and Server 2003 SP2 on top of the One-Core-API base; D3D Native is 'based on native Windows Directx Runtime' (Microsoft binaries from later Windows) and Modern Setup adds a Vista-like Sysprep/OOBE. Not a clean-origin mod. NOT DOWNLOADED, NOT HASHED. read 2026-11-25

xp.name: 7-Zip 26.06 (32-bit)
xp.licence: LGPL-2.1 (most code), BSD-3-Clause parts, unRAR licence restriction
xp.notes: 7-Zip 26.06 (2026-11-06), the current release. The 7-zip.org home page states '7-Zip works in Windows 11 / 10 / 8 / 7 / Vista / XP / 2022 / 2019 / 2016 / 2012 / 2008 / 2003 / 2000', so the current version is the last XP-capable one. Download link taken from 7-zip.org (it points to the author's ip7z/7zip GitHub release); the hash matches the GitHub release asset digest. Silent: the 7-zip.org FAQ documents /S (silent) and /D="C:\Program Files\7-Zip" (output directory), case-sensitive. Not Authenticode-signed (signer empty). read 2026-11-25

xp.name: VLC media player 3.0.24 (32-bit)
xp.notes: VLC 3.0.24, the current 3.0.x release on videolan.org; the Windows download page states 'VLC runs on all versions of Windows, from Windows XP SP3 to the last version of Windows 11' (3.0.x is the XP-capable series). download.videolan.org redirects to a mirror (this copy came from ftp.icm.edu.pl); the hash matches VideoLAN's published vlc-3.0.24-win32.exe.sha256. Silent: the VideoLAN wiki page Documentation:Installing_VLC documents "/L=<languagecode> /S" (1045 = Polish, 1033 = English). Signed by VideoLAN. read 2026-11-25

xp.name: foobar2000 1.5.12
xp.licence: freeware (foobar2000 licence: redistribution of unmodified installers only; bundled libraries LGPL-2.1/BSD/MIT)
xp.notes: foobar2000.org/old lists 'Final for Windows XP & no-SSE CPU: v1.5.12'; foobar2000.org/old-pc says the current version needs Windows 7 and SSE2 and 'Windows XP and pre-SSE2 processors are supported by foobar2000 v1.5.x series'. Closed-source freeware by Peter Pawlowski. No vendor-documented silent switch found on foobar2000.org (third-party sites claim NSIS /S; not recorded). Not Authenticode-signed (signer empty). read 2026-11-25

xp.name: Charon Hypervisor TLS proxy
xp.notes: Conceptual member of this group: the hypervisor's own TLS proxy terminates modern TLS on the host side so the XP guest (IE6/IE8, old WinHTTP/SChannel without TLS 1.2/1.3 and modern roots) can reach current HTTPS sites. Nothing third-party is downloaded or installed in the guest for it, and no POSReady TLS update is used. Root store refresh and modern browsers are covered by other groups in manifests.json (certificates: legacy-update-xp and ms-trustedr-*; browser: supermium-32-xp, mypal-xp). read 2026-11-25
